Inventory valuation (quantity × cost per variant per location)

post.description: Validates x-hub-signature-256 and processes inbound messages.

post.description: Maps a Meta phone_number_id to this tenant so inbound messages are routed correctly.

get.summary: Get guided setup checklist for this merchant
get.description: Returns which onboarding steps are complete and which are pending. Poll this endpoint to drive a guided first-time setup UI.

post.summary: Configure logistics provider for this tenant
post.description: Store encrypted API key + webhook secret for a logistics provider (e.g. traka). For TRAKA: the merchant must first register on TRAKA, get approved, and create an API key. BPOS stores the key encrypted — it is never returned in plaintext.

post.summary: Dispatch an order via the configured logistics provider
post.description: Order must be in PROCESSING status and have a deliveryAddress set. On success the order transitions to DISPATCHED.

get.summary: Get live tracking status for a dispatched order

post.summary: Upload and compress an image (product photo, expense receipt, etc.)
post.description: Accepts a single multipart image file (jpeg/png/webp), compresses it, and returns a public URL to attach to other resources (e.g. imageUrl, receiptUrl).

get.summary: List valid Nigerian state names for zone/rate configuration

post.summary: Create a shipping zone (named group of Nigerian states)

post.description: type values: flat_rate | zone_rate | value_rate | weight_rate | automated | free | pick_up. flat_rate requires flatRateKobo. free with isFreeAlways=true is always visible at checkout. free without isFreeAlways uses conditions (POST /shipping/methods/:id/conditions). zone_rate / value_rate / weight_rate require rates (POST /shipping/methods/:id/rates). automated uses the configured logistics provider for a live quote. pick_up always returns NGN 0 — customer must also choose a pick-up location.

post.summary: Add a rate row to a zone_rate / value_rate / weight_rate method
post.description: For zone_rate: set zoneId (or omit for catch-all). For value_rate: set min/maxOrderValueKobo. For weight_rate: set min/maxWeightKg. maxOrderValueKobo / maxWeightKg can be omitted for "and above" tiers.

get.summary: List rate rows for a shipping method

delete.summary: Remove a rate row from a shipping method

post.summary: Add a condition to a free shipping method

get.summary: List conditions for a free shipping method

delete.summary: Remove a condition from a free shipping method

post.summary: Create a pick-up location (merchant branch or third-party collection point)

get.summary: List active pick-up locations (public — no auth required)
get.description: Called by the customer-facing storefront. Filter by Nigerian state with ?state=Lagos.

get.summary: Get available shipping methods and fees for a given checkout context
get.description: Called at checkout after the customer provides their delivery details. Returns options sorted cheapest-first. automated methods are excluded — use GET /shipping/quote for live provider quotes.
